A tie for the highest Version.Priority among eligible Active, date-covering configuration versions is IssueCode=TAX_CONFIGURATION_AMBIGUOUS - a blocking issue on that one employee's row only, NOT a whole-run failure (unlike qa/13-statutory-compliance's F-STAT-036 which fails the whole employee's PAYROLL calculation)

Zero matching configuration/version is IssueCode=TAX_CONFIGURATION_MISSING; zero matching StatutorySlab (FromAmount<=taxable<=ToAmount-or-null, OptionalMonth must be null - this engine never matches an OptionalMonth-restricted slab at all, unlike the monthly engine) is IssueCode=TAX_SLAB_MISSING - both are per-employee blocking issues, incrementing run.BlockingIssueCount, not silent skips (a materially different failure mode than qa/13-statutory-compliance's F-STAT-037/044 silent-continue)

A matched slab's tax is PayrollRoundingPolicy.RoundMoney(FixedAmount + taxable*Rate/100) - the identical rounding policy and formula shape as the monthly engine's own slab math, applied here to the FULL annual taxable income in one shot rather than per-period

An employee row's Status is BlockingIssue if any tax-resolution issue occurred (regardless of EstimatedTaxDue), else AdjustmentRecommended if EstimatedTaxDue>0, else Reconciled - EstimatedExcessTax alone never drives a distinct Status value (an all-excess, zero-due employee is still classified Reconciled, the same as an exactly-matched employee)
